model: RIBTWX240xB-BC / RIBMNWX240xB-BC BACnet relay (1 relay, 2 inputs)
applies_to: Functional Devices RIBTWX240xB-BC (enclosed) and RIBMNWX240xB-BC (board) BACnet MS/TP relays with one relay output and two binary inputs.
summary: A BACnet MS/TP relay with one relay (BO1) and two binary inputs (BI1, BI2). All three objects are plain I/O with user-writable names; there is no on-board control logic.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, BO1...).
BO1 has a 16-level priority array and writable minimum on / off times (0-65535 s); polarity and active / inactive texts are writable on every object.
The PICS lists AnalogInput among the supported object types, but the object list has only BI1, BI2 and BO1.

integration.summary: Write BO1 to switch the relay and read BI1 and BI2 for the inputs.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; the PICS lists 9600-115200 baud. Max_Master defaults to 127.
